label: Pruning
type: the deletion of backups past backup:retention-period, automatic (scheduled) or manual (triggered on demand). Distinct from backup:prune-task, which is the specific task_type enum value a backup:plan schedules to perform this operation - pruning is the process/mechanism, prune-task is its scheduled-execution unit.
evidence: You can also set the Backup Service to prune backups that have exceeded the retention period.
When the retention period is reached, the Backup Service automatically deletes the backup through Prune tasks.
Triggers an immediate pruning of backups for the specified active repository. As a result, the need to wait for a scheduled pruning can be skipped when required.
note: Extraction-layer since round 19; crosses the promotion bar this round via backup-retention.md and backup-trigger-prune.md, both of which reuse it in a relation slot alongside the newly-promoted sibling backup:prune-task.
relates_to_competency_question: What triggers the deletion of an expired backup, and can it be run on demand?
